rationale: Glucose depleted; switching to lactate and arabinose as primary carbon sources. Heterofermentative fermentation produces acetate, formate, propionate, and CO₂. Arginine and ammonium provide nitrogen. Carbon balance: 27 mmol C in, 9 for biomass, 18 as fermentation products. Nitrogen: 3.5 mmol in, 2.4 for biomass, excess released.
